डत्करिका: डत्करिका (का) 1. f. Sweetmeat made of milk, treacle and ghee.
ड: ड ḍ The third letter of the 3d class.
ड (डः-डा) 1. m. Shiva; fear; sub-marine fire; kind of drum or tabor. f. An imp; a basket car-ried by a sling.
डप्: डप् (क, कि, इ) डापयति; डम्पति, यति 1. 10. a. To collect or accumulate.
डब्: डब् (इ) डम्बयति 10. a. To throw, to send. With वि to deceive.
डभ्: डभ् (कि, इ) डम्भति डम्भयति, ते 1. 10. a. To collect, to heap together.
डमर: डमर (रः-रा) 1. m. f. An affray; ter-rifying by shouts; predatory warfare; rout. n. Flight.
डमरु: डमरु (रुः) 2. m. Musical instrument, small drum; strange event.
डयन: डयन (नं) 1. n. A car or litter car-ried on the shoulders; a flying.
डलक: डलक (कः) 1. m. Sling, basket, dūlī, for carrying presents of fruit, &c.
डाकिनी: डाकिनी (नी) 3. f. Kind of female imp.
डामर: डामर (रः) 1. m. Affray; rout, up-roar; strange event; a tantra.
डाहल: डाहल (लः) 1. m. A name of a country.
डाहुक: डाहुक (कः) 1. m. A gallinule; a fat man; a slave; a cheat.
डिङ्गर: डिङ्गर (रः) 1. m. Throwing; a fat man; a slave; a cheat.
डिण्डिम: डिण्डिम (मः) 1. m. A musical instru-ment, kind of drum or tabor; a plant (Carissa carondas).
डिण्डिर: डिण्डिर (रः) 1. m. Cuttle fish bone considered as foam of the sea.
डिप्: डिप् (य, श, क) डिप्यति, डिपति, डेपयति 4. 6. 10. a. To throw, send. (कि, इ) डिम्पति, यति 1. 10. a. To collect.
डिब्: डिब् (इ, क) डिम्बयति 10 a. To throw.
डिभ्: डिभ् (कि, इ) डिम्भति डिम्भयति 1. 10. a. To collect, to heap together.

डिम्भ: डिम्भ (म्भः) 1. m. Any young animal; an egg; a fool. f. An infant.
डिम्भचक्र: डिम्भ-चक्र (क्रं) 1. n. A diagram for predicting fortunes.
डी: डी (ङ) डयते 1. d. To fly, to go. (य) डीयते 4. d. Idem. With अव to fly down; with उत् to fly up; with परि to fly round; with प्र to fly well; with समुत् to fly together; to fly up together.
डीनडीनक: डीन-डीनक (कं) 1. n. Flying reite-ratedly, or repeatedly.

डोर: डोर (रं) 1. n. A thread tied round the wrist or round a parcel.
